title: Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026 - Implementation
description: <cite index="43-4,43-6">The RBI notified the Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2026, replacing the 2021 framework, to strengthen and streamline consumer grievance redress across regulated financial entities. Effective from 1 July 2026, RB-IOS provides a cost-free, expeditious, and non-adversarial mechanism for resolving complaints against banks, eligible NBFCs, non-bank PPI issuers, and credit information companies.</cite>
